name: UI Toolkit DevTools
description: Use for Unity 6.3+ UI Toolkit debugging in Editor windows and Play Mode runtime UIDocuments: inspect panels and element trees, read resolved styles and matched USS rules, preview inline layout edits, drive semantic interaction, wait for UI state, and highlight targets for viewport capture.
argumentHint: <inspect, style, layout, or interact with UI Toolkit>

command.argumentHint: <inspect, style, layout, or interact with UI Toolkit>

tools.name: unity-ui-list-panels
tools.description: List live UI Toolkit panels in the connected Unity Editor. Includes EditorWindow panels and runtime UIDocument panels while Play Mode is running, with stable session panel IDs and capture hints.

includeEmpty.description: Include panels whose visual tree currently has no descendants. Defaults to false.

tools.name: unity-ui-inspect
tools.description: Inspect a UI Toolkit panel or subtree as a bounded flat element graph. Returns stable session element IDs, hierarchy, text/value/state, layout bounds, actionable operations, optional resolved style, optional matched USS source rules, and hit-test diagnostics.

elementId.description: Optional element ID returned by an earlier inspection; scopes the result to that subtree.

selector.description: Optional CSS-lite selector scoped to the panel: #name, .class, Type, Type#name, Type.class, or *.

includeHidden.description: Include elements hidden by display, visibility, or opacity. Defaults to false.

interactiveOnly.description: Return only actionable or focusable elements while preserving their IDs and parent references.

includeComputedStyle.description: Include the commonly useful resolved style properties for each returned element.

includeMatchedRules.description: Include matching USS asset paths, line numbers, and specificity when Unity exposes rule diagnostics.

tools.name: unity-ui-style
tools.description: Preview atomic inline UI Toolkit style edits on one live element, reset inline properties, or roll back a prior preview. Returns a preview ID and refreshed element diagnostics. Persistent USS/UXML edits should use the source paths returned by inspection.

operation.description: Apply inline values, clear inline properties, or restore a preview's previous inline values.

previewId.description: Preview ID returned by a prior set/reset operation; required for rollback.

property.description: USS kebab-case or IStyle camelCase property name.

value.description: USS-style value such as 12px, 40%, auto, flex, none, #ffcc00, or 0.8.

tools.name: unity-ui-action
tools.description: Drive one live UI Toolkit element through semantic value changes or targeted UI events. Supports click, focus, setValue, type, toggle, select, scroll, press, and drag; works for Editor panels and Play Mode runtime panels.

value.description: Value for setValue/select/toggle; JSON scalar values are accepted.

tools.name: unity-ui-wait
tools.description: Wait without blocking the Unity main thread until an element exists, disappears, becomes visible/hidden/enabled/disabled, reaches text/value, or keeps a stable layout for several editor updates.

tools.name: unity-ui-highlight
tools.description: Add or clear a non-interactive diagnostic overlay on a UI Toolkit panel. Highlight one element or number visible interactive elements, then use unity_capture_viewport with the panel's captureTarget and requestEditorStatus to obtain an image.
